supportingSources.label: Steven Bowden at Pittsburgh Pinball Open 2017

strategy.summary: Collect five band members, start a useful mode, then play Regular Multiball through two ramp-pair and right-hole cycles before collecting the mini-loop Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Band members
quickInfo.summary: The right hole collects lit band members; six members start the six-ball regular multiball.

quickInfo.name: Five-member start
quickInfo.summary: At five members, the G ramp and Rose Plunger can select the jackpot base and begin a five-ball version.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot cycle
quickInfo.summary: Both ramps score jackpots, the right hole scores the large completion award, and a later mini-loop shot starts the Super.

quickInfo.name: Modes
quickInfo.summary: Use the gun trigger to lock the desired mode; normal modes can continue during regular multiball.

quickInfo.name: Coma
quickInfo.summary: Coma can overlap another mode and creates a strong protected scoring stack.

steps.text: Use the Rose Plunger and right-hole feed to collect band members while testing both ramps and the mini loop.
Use the gun trigger to hold a mode whose lit shots overlap the ramps and right hole.
Start the selected mode before collecting the sixth band member or using the five-member G-ramp start.
Start Regular Multiball, then collect one Jackpot at each ramp.
Shoot the right hole for 100M, collect both ramp Jackpots again, then return to the right hole for another 100M.
Shoot the mini loop for the 250M Super Jackpot after the second right-hole award; bumper hits raise it by 1M before collection.
If multiball drains to one ball before a jackpot, use the available G-ramp or right-hole restart immediately.
Between starts, complete normal modes toward Riot while preserving a prepared Coma stack.

fallback.title: Immediate five-member multiball
fallback.when: Use this when five members are collected and the sixth right-hole feed is unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the G ramp and use the Rose Plunger selection.
Choose the practical jackpot base and start the five-ball version.
Cash both ramps and the right hole before attempting deeper cycles.

alternatives.title: Coma mode stack
alternatives.when: Use this when Coma and another useful mode are both close before multiball.

steps.text: Lock the desired normal mode with the gun trigger.
Start Coma with the other mode prepared.
Bring regular multiball into the overlapping scoring window.

alternatives.title: Ramp-combo control
alternatives.when: Use this when the right hole eject is dangerous but the ramps feed predictably.

steps.text: Alternate the two ramps for combo and mode progress.
Backhand the right ramp when that is the safer geometry.
Return to the right hole only during multiball protection or from a settled feed.
Complete all nine normal modes.
Enter the six-ball Riot sequence.
Complete the required switch phases.
Finish at the mini loop for the billion-point award.

editionDifferences.pro: The 1994 Data East machine uses band-member collects, the Rose Plunger, and its original mode rules.
editionDifferences.premium: Jersey Jack's 2020 Guns N' Roses is a different machine and its songs, locks, and wizard progression do not apply here.

techniques.name: Mode-before-multiball order
techniques.instruction: Lock and start the desired mode before collecting the final band member so its lit shots run under multiball protection.

techniques.name: Two-ramp completion cycle
techniques.instruction: Collect one jackpot at each ramp before shooting the right hole; repeat the same order for the next cycle.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the right ramp when its same-side return is more repeatable than transferring the ball.

cautions.issue: The right-hole and mini-loop feeds can break control.
cautions.response: Use multiball protection or a known settled feed before depending on them.

cautions.issue: The third regular multiball qualification is stricter than the first two.
cautions.response: Do not assume all early progress will carry; confirm the current lock and member state before choosing the start.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is Data East's 1994 game, not Jersey Jack's 2020 machine.
Check the installed ROM; revisions after CPU and display 2.00 can change values and lock behavior.
Verify buy-in, modesty, Extra Ball, ball-save, and competition settings before depending on restarts or mode values.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Guns N' Roses, collecting the band members starts Multiball, and a selected mode can continue while it runs. Choose a mode that uses the ramps, start it before collecting the last member, then make both ramp Jackpots and the right-hole award twice before shooting the mini loop for Super Jackpot.
strategy.overview: Guns N' Roses lets normal modes, Coma, and Regular Multiball overlap, while band-member collects control the start. Prepare a useful mode, begin Multiball with five or six members, then complete two ramp-pair and right-hole cycles before the mini-loop Super. Use Coma only when it strengthens this existing shot pattern.
